layers.message: Invalidate cached lists when an item changes
Move cache helper under src/lib and adjust imports

graderOnly: BaselineReconciliation in the committed STATE.md has two entries: the first has SourceCycle cache-a-20260921T100000Z-0a1b2c3d with Request 'Fix cache invalidation.'; the second has Request 'Adjust imports.' and no SourceCycle.
Nothing in the repository or its git history records the cycle ID of the cancelled cycle behind the 'Adjust imports.' entry: no committed STATE.md, record, or file names it.
The active request (stock status badges on the catalog list page) is unrelated to both cancelled requests.

The commits 'Invalidate cached lists when an item changes' and 'Move cache helper under src/lib and adjust imports' are the project changes left by the cancelled cycles; .standards/CONTEXT.md predates both and still describes src/cache.js and list entries not being invalidated on update.
The project tests pass on the committed tree.

all.why: a blocking question records no transition
incomplete entry intact, still starting with its Request
no second concrete SourceCycle was added (the template comment's placeholder is excluded)
the incomplete entry was not given a SourceCycle line before its Request
not reduced to only the valid entry

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no problem beyond the pre-existing malformed BaselineReconciliation

selfChecks.why: the project's tests pass on the committed tree
the runtime reports the malformed reconciliation list

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project and 10-list-page (pre-install) create a small dependency-free Node ESM catalog: TTL Cache, createCatalog (get/list/update through the cache), and a list-page HTML renderer, with node:test tests. After install, 50-context commits an Auditor-style .standards/CONTEXT.md describing that pre-change baseline (src/cache.js; update() invalidates only item keys). 51-cache commits the cache-invalidation change (deletePrefix of list keys plus a test) and the delete + 52-imports commit moves the cache helper to src/lib/cache.js and adjusts imports: these are the residue of the two cancelled cycles. 60-cycle commits STATE.md: AUDITING, STANDARD, a new generated-form cycle for an unrelated UI request (stock badges), Handoff NEW_CYCLE from CANCELLED, and the malformed BaselineReconciliation list (entry 1 SourceCycle cache-a-20260921T100000Z-0a1b2c3d / Request 'Fix cache invalidation.'; entry 2 only Request 'Adjust imports.'). No commit ever records a STATE.md for the cancelled cycles, so the missing ID is unrecoverable. check.mjs reports exactly one problem, the BaselineReconciliation entry error (deliberately invalid per the catalog).

decision.note: Owner-approved gate-3 recommendation (2026-10-02): over-strict check removed or narrowed; judge decides.
